full_judgment: 2. The Short fact is that the respondent as plaintiff instituted the aforesaid Title Suit No. 13 of 2002 against the defendant-petitioners for a decree of permanent injunction in respect of the suit land alleging, inter alia, that the suit land appertaining to Mouza No. 202 Sundarpur, Chatkhil, Noakhali in Khatian No. 37 originally belonged to one Meher Ali and others. Meher Ali died after the death of his only son, Badsha Mia, who left behind his only son Abdur Rahman, Meher Ali transferred the land of Khatian No. 37 along with other lands by Heba in favour of his grand-son Abdur Rahman on 6.8.1920. The said Meher Ali also transferred 1.22 acres of land to one Abdul Aziz tafadar, who again transferred the same to Abdur Rahman through several registered deeds and in this manner Abdur Rahman became the owner and possessor of 2.22 acres of land under Khatian Nos. 37 and 40. Abdur Rahman died leaving two sons, Md. Hanif, the plaintiff-respondent and Mohammad Hossain, predecessor of the defendant-petitioners and a daughter, Fatema Khatun. As per law of inheritance, the plaintiff and the defendants became owner of 88 4/5 decimals of land equally and Fatema Khatun became owner of 42/5 decimals of land. Mohammad Hossain, the predecessor of the defendants on an amicable settlement handed over possession of 90 decimals of land under Dag Nos. 1123, 1124, 1126 and 1127 to the plaintiff, Md. Hanif and Fatema Khatun. While the plaintiff was in possession of the suit land some miscreants tried to dispossess him from the suit land when he filed an application before then Martial Law court which upon holding enquiry handed over possession of 1.20 acres of land under Dag Nos. 1123, 1124, 1126, 1127, 1148 and 1149 to the plaintiff and the rest of the land to the predecessor of the defendants by preparing sketch map of the land. Thereafter, the plaintiff had been possessing the suit land and constructed a house in dag No. 1123. The defendants have been residing in the old house and an unregistered deed was signed amicably between the plaintiff and his brother Mohammad Hossain, the predecessor of the defendants on 10.9.1993 in which their sister Fatema Khatun and her husband and two other were made witnesses. Fatema Khatun, the sister of the plaintiff transferred her share in favour of the plaintiff by two registered deeds dated 15.11.2001 and 2.1.2002 and handed over possession of the land and in this way, the plaintiff has exclusively been possessing 90 decimals of land within the knowledge of the defendants and others and the defendants have also been possessing their land specifically and separately. The defendants threatened the plaintiff on 13.1.2002 for dispossessing him from the suit land illegally and forcibly for which the plaintiff was compelled to file the suit.
